notes.title: "Candy Disaster" version 3.0.0 update will be available on July 27th
notes.content:
[h1] "Candy Disaster" version 3.0.0 update will be available on July 27th[/h1]

[h2]1. Arcade Trap Pack[/h2]
The Arcade Traps Pack includes 3 traps:
[b]Gravity Magnet[/b]: (ground trap)
Release the force field to attract all enemies within a grid, gather the enemies and slow them down for a period of time.
[b]Suicide Attack[/b]: (replace trap)
If a unit (non-explosive soldier) dies within the range of the Suicide Attack, a self-destruct soldier will be recruited. The self-explosive soldiers will automatically find enemies within a certain range to launch a self-explosive Attack.
[b]Penalty Blade[/b]: (Wall Trap)
When one of your units dies on the field, fire a flying blade that deals damage equal to half the Health of the dead unit.
(Our units such as: Cold Swordsman and Sharp Shooter, Self-Destructive Soldiers)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36684116/893b86f35273282b3a131ea495747beb0df6705a.png[/img]
The three traps complete and assist each other. The Gravity Magnet will ensure that the enemies will be concentrated around the Suicide Attack battalion to be killed, and the self-explosive soldiers generated by the Suicide Attack battalion will trigger the Penalty Blade to launch flying blade. Of course, their existing traps also have many linkages. For example, flying blade can also be affected by other traps to bring attributes, and the self-destruction of self-destruct soldiers can also trigger an explosion of poison gas.

[h2]2. Daily challenge mode[/h2]
The new [b]Daily Challenge mode[/b] has been updated, and the Arcade Trap can be unlocked when player clearing the daily challenge for the first time. In the daily challenge mode, players all over the world will play the game on the map, and upload their final score on the daily ranking list. Daily challenges will also have different strings and buffs, as well as banned traps. With the blessing of the buff, the enemies on the grass may also be unable to be killed by the water just like the enemies on the snow land. Of course, buffs are not all about difficulty increases. Players will also have random enhancements. The buffs and maps of the daily challenge will change daily, guaranteeing new challenges for players every day, and at the same time giving players around the world the opportunity to compete with each other and see who is the real trap master!

notes.title: Looking for Alpha Testers for Candy Disaster's Sequel :)
notes.content:
Dear Candy Guardians,

Remember when we said we've been working on our second game [i][b]Trap Master[/b][/i] (sequel to Candy Disaster)?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2330870/CD2_TrapMaster

[h3]The first demo will be ready soon, and we are looking for alpha testers![/h3] 
We want to deliver a sequel that takes the best of Candy Disaster and adds fresh gameplay for both new and returning players. Your support and feedback will be tremendously helpful!

[h3]How to Take Part in Alpha Test?[/h3]
[olist]
[*] [url=https://forms.gle/1PQ1JSADkn9rrW9S9][b]Please sign up by filling out this form[/b][/url]
[*] Selected testers will [b]receive Steam keys via email[/b] by 09:00 April 14 (GMT+00:00)
[*] Launch your Steam client and activate the game with the key!
[*] The test will lasts for 3 days: 09:00 April 14 - 09:00 April 17 (GMT+00:00)
[/olist]

[h3]Content of the Demo[/h3]
In this demo, you will be able to learn the basics of the game in a roguelike map, where you can get familiar with the main mechanics of the game: build a deck, play the cards to lay down traps and launch attacks to win tower-defense combats, and make the most of mysterious encounters on the way.

[h3]Your Feedback Means A LOT![/h3]
This is the first demo so bugs or other issues are possible. We call for your understanding and patience. We're hoping to gather feedback primarily on gameplay, and many of the in-game art assets are only temporary.

Tell us what you think via the [b]in-game survey[/b], or [b]join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/cUmXQts5ms]Discord server[/url][/b] to get in touch with the team!

Thank you!
ACE

notes.title: Announcing Our New Game TrapMaster - Wishlist Now!
notes.content:
Hey candy guards!

It's with much excitement that we announce our second game, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2330870/CD2_TrapMaster/]Candy Disaster: TrapMaster[/url][/b]! 

As the sequel to Candy Disaster, it will feature your favorite tower defense designs, but with the addition of roguelike elements to keep you on your toes, and a twist of deckbuilding mechanism for smooth-flowing gameplay.

In TrapMaster, you'll go through a procedurally generated map filled with mysteries and dangers. You start with a few trap cards, and pick up new cards/upgrades/items on your climb to form a deck that will keep you going until you meet the final boss. 

During the turn-based battles, play your hand to set up traps or launch attacks on the enemies to guard your tower!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36684116/055e4522cc8e027c7615a76f9896b5ab3c1b8f1c.jpg[/img]

We're also experimenting with a different art direction, using a gray and muddy style to bring out a darker mood and atmosphere (well a space adventure is not all rainbows and unicorns). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36684116/5aa8fcc9faac31b4ccc10ab386374061f09c9871.png[/img]

We can't wait to show it to you guys! We're planning to finish our first demo soon to launch a playtest! We look forward to hearing your feedback and perfecting the game!

[h3]Wishlist Candy Disaster: TrapMaster and stay tuned for more updates and playtest news![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2330870/CD2_TrapMaster

Cheers,
Klaus

notes.title: A letter to players of Candy Disaster
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

10 months of Early Access is finally coming to an end. Candy Crash will be released in full on November 12th with the long awaited Snow Map!

Before we launch a more complete game with more and richer gameplay, I'm sure many players have noticed that we've made a move to lower the price of the game.

It wasn't an easy decision to make. But after a series of decisions, we have chosen to reduce the price to make the game more visible and accessible to a wider audience.

We appreciate and value the players who have been with us since Early Access, Thank you to the players who supported the purchase before the implementation of the price adjustment plan and helped us to promote it. Everyone's love and support is our greatest motivation. We will refund the difference in price for players who purchased the game before the price increase was implemented.

As Steam does not support price protection or other features, we are unable to refund the difference directly through Steam. If you would like to receive a refund for the difference in price, please click on the questionnaire below, fill in the appropriate information and wait for the refund to be processed.

Details of how to get a refund can be found in the questionnaire
Refund information collection:[url=https://wj.qq.com/s2/9270099/d411/]https://wj.qq.com/s2/9270099/d411/[/url]

Refunds will normally arrive within 1-7 working days after you have filled in all the information, as they are all manual and may be missed . If you have not received your refund for a long time, please feel free to contact us via the following methods
[u]Email: publish@vgjump.com[/u]

Once again, we would like to thank all of you who have chosen to support us over the past 10 months and hope that Candy Disaster will bring you more happiness in the future.

PS. The refund period is from November 12, 2021 to December 12, 2021. We will compare the price at the time of your purchase to the price now in the area after the price adjustment and issue a refund.

notes.title: 【活动名称】糖果灾难 第一届攻略征集大赛
notes.content:
不好啦！随着沙漠大乱斗的到来，关卡也越来越“阴间”，策划大魔王已经杀疯啦！刚入门的新玩家急需大家的帮助。为了让更多的玩家能够实现糖果自由，我们计划启动防萌新脱坑应急预案。希望各位经验老道的陷阱大师们可以伸出你们的援手！

为了让更多玩家能够更快的在我们游戏感受到乐趣（受苦），我们将向广大糖果爱好者征集关卡攻略！你可以是一名标准合格的人民教师拯救众多萌新走出黑暗森林保护自己的糖果，你也可以是整活王道的诡术陷阱王，让萌新眼花缭乱根本无法跟上你的操作。从马飞飞手中守护萌新吧，这个世界需要更多的光之导师。毕竟能力越大，奖励也越大！

[b]【活动时间】[/b]
[u]6月24日00:00 -7月15日19:00[/u]

[b]【活动内容】[/b]
1.录制糖果灾难游戏相关的攻略视频在B站进行视频投稿，并选择“单机游戏”分区，带上“糖果灾难”标签。攻略视频不限关卡，玩家可以制作单个视频也可以制作视频合集进行投稿。

2.我们将从B站内所有符合投稿规则的攻略视频里，按照“播放量+互动量+视频质量”进行综合评定后，送出以下的奖励

[b]【活动奖励】[/b]
第1名 50美金Steam充值卡
第2-3名 20美金Steam充值卡
第4-5名 10美金Steam充值卡

[b]特殊奖项[/b]
最强整活王 50美金Steam充值卡
最佳导师奖 50美金Steam充值卡

[b]参与奖[/b]
只要参与攻略赛视频发布，并且向Q群小助手发送过报名信息，我们将会在参赛玩家中抽取3名未获奖的参与者，获得5美元充值卡1张。

[b]【活动规则】[/b]
1.每位参与玩家，需要制作糖果灾难任意关卡的攻略视频，发布在B站指定的分区后，加入我们糖果灾难吃糖群（群号：148308968），将“steam昵称+B站视频链接”发送给群内官方小助手“不愿透露姓名的知名助手”，才算参赛成功。（鉴于早期活动提交微博回链，存在大量吞噬情况，固本次进行调整，烦请加入吃糖群私聊小助手提供参赛凭证。）
2.视频命名需包含此关键词：《糖果灾难》 攻略。
3.视频攻略不限定关卡，官方将还会在发奖前对视频内容进行验证，不可发布他人视频链接，一旦发现取消参赛资格。
4.禁止使用任何修改软件进行修改，一经发现直接取消参赛资格。
5.活动最终排名以及“特殊奖励”将由糖果灾难项目组依据“播放量+互动量+视频质量”进行综合评定（友情提示：视频质量划重点）


[b]【注意事项】[/b]
1. 官方将只会在页面下已发送链接的玩家中进行审核与抽选。
2. 获奖玩家领取奖励时需要添加官方小助手为QQ好友提供steam相关ID个人资料截图，以便核实身份。 
3. 同一个视频有可能同时获得名次和特殊奖项，但是参与奖将只在未获奖的参赛视频中抽取。

[b]【官方小建议】[/b]
因为这次是较为友好的功略向视频，官方建议但不强制大家使用正常进度中该关卡已解锁的陷阱。方便萌新玩家对照视频进行攻略思路的学习。


PS：本期大乱斗比赛为第一期，大家随时准备好，后续将会不断有新活动推出！敬请期待吧！
